content.title: Seagate Stock Is Getting Crushed. Here’s What Spooked the Market.
content.summary: Shares of data storage and memory chip companies like  Western Digital Seagate Technology  and  Micron Technology  fell Thursday after Japanese competitor  Kioxia Holdings  reported a steep drop in profit.
